tools.name: yoco_list_payments
tools.description: List card payments for the business with status, amount, fees and refund totals. Filter by status or created/updated date. Yoco API: GET /v1/payments/.

tools.name: yoco_get_payment
tools.description: Fetch one payment by id, including its refunds and processing fees. Yoco API: GET /v1/payments/{payment_id}.

tools.name: yoco_list_orders
tools.description: List point-of-sale and online orders with status, amounts and line items. Filter by status, location or date. Yoco API: GET /v1/orders/.

tools.name: yoco_get_order
tools.description: Fetch one order by id, with its line items, taxes, discounts and amounts. Yoco API: GET /v1/orders/{order_id}.

tools.name: yoco_list_refunds
tools.description: List refunds with status and amount. Filter by status or created/updated date. Yoco API: GET /v1/refunds/.

tools.name: yoco_get_refund
tools.description: Fetch one refund by id. Yoco API: GET /v1/refunds/{refund_id}.

tools.name: yoco_list_payouts
tools.description: List payouts to the business bank account with status and amount. Yoco API: GET /v1/payouts/.

tools.name: yoco_get_payout
tools.description: Fetch one payout by id. Yoco API: GET /v1/payouts/{payout_id}.

tools.name: yoco_list_payout_entries
tools.description: List the entries that make up one payout (payments, refunds and fees), to reconcile a bank deposit. Yoco API: GET /v1/payouts/{payout_id}/payout_entries.

tools.name: yoco_list_payment_links
tools.description: List payment links with status (pending, paid, cancelled). Yoco API: GET /v1/payment_links/.

tools.name: yoco_get_payment_link
tools.description: Fetch one payment link by id, including its public URL and status. Yoco API: GET /v1/payment_links/{payment_link_id}.

tools.name: yoco_create_payment_link
tools.description: Create a payment link that a customer can pay online. The amount is in the smallest currency unit (cents for ZAR). Creates a real, payable link. Yoco API: POST /v1/payment_links/.

tools.name: yoco_delete_payment_link
tools.description: Delete a payment link so customers can no longer pay it. This cannot be undone. Yoco API: DELETE /v1/payment_links/{payment_link_id}.

tools.name: yoco_list_items
tools.description: List catalogue items (products and services) with price and category. Yoco API: GET /v1/items/.

tools.name: yoco_get_item
tools.description: Fetch one catalogue item by id, with its variants and options. Yoco API: GET /v1/items/{item_id}.

tools.name: yoco_list_locations
tools.description: List the business locations (shops or sites) with status. Yoco API: GET /v1/locations/.

tools.name: yoco_get_location
tools.description: Fetch one business location by id. Yoco API: GET /v1/locations/{location_id}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: yoco_get_payment_link · Public sink: yoco_create_payment_link · Destructive: yoco_delete_payment_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: yoco_get_payment_link · Public sink: yoco_create_payment_link · Destructive: yoco_delete_payment_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
